name: Tree Select
description: Select-style field that opens a tree in its dropdown for choosing a single node from hierarchical data, following the WAI-ARIA combobox pattern with a tree popup.

properties.name: placeholder
properties.label: Placeholder
properties.description: Shown while no node is chosen

properties.name: hint
properties.label: Hint
properties.defaultValue: Any category can be a parent, including a leaf.

properties.name: size
properties.label: Size
properties.description: Field size; the tree rows follow it

properties.name: clearable
properties.label: Clearable
properties.description: Show a button that clears the chosen node

events.name: valueChange
events.label: Value Change
events.payloadDescription: Id of the chosen node, or null after clearing (string | null)
